name: Pilisszentiván (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pilisszentiván (a blue and white shield with crossed hammers and a Hungarian shield, with a helm, a crown and red and blue mantling) above the name PILISSZENTIVÁN in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pilisszentiván arms with helm, crown and mantling
